test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Armature and Coil Winder) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is INCORRECT about line standard?

options.text: Quick measurements over a wide range
More accurate due to line thickness
Used to measure the distance between two engraved lines

solution:
The correct answer is __More accurate due to line thickness****.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Line standards__ are used to measure the distance between two engraved lines.
 
• They are quick measurements over a wide range.
 
• Parallax error is a common issue while using line standards.
 
• Line thickness makes it less accurate.
 
• These standards are primarily used in engineering and precision measurement contexts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **End standards:**
 
 
• End standards measure the distance between two flat surfaces.
 
• They are highly accurate and free from parallax error.
 
 
 
• **Line standards vs End standards:**
 
 
• Line standards are less accurate than end standards due to line thickness.
 
• End standards are preferred in applications requiring higher precision.
